prompt:

Asset type: horizontal editorial cover photograph for a Spanish publication about AI and work
Primary request: a regional power-grid engineer walks beneath high-voltage lines across a windswept hillside, surveying the landscape that infrastructure and AI systems depend on.
Scene/backdrop: open European countryside with pylons, distant hills and grasses, no signs.
Style/medium: wide environmental photojournalism, human scale in a real landscape, subtle 35mm film grain.
Composition/framing: cinematic 16:9 landscape, engineer in foreground, power lines crossing the sky.
Lighting/mood: late overcast daylight, a restrained red safety detail, expansive and thoughtful.
Color palette: near-black earth shadows, muted greens and slate sky, small red accent.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark; safe realistic work.
Avoid: office, paperwork, screens, robots, disaster spectacle, generic AI imagery.
